lines: d12: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kate Bernstein is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d12: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d12: 🕯️ Kate Bernstein is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d12: What Kate kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d12: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Heinrich blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d12: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d12: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d12: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Kate Bernstein, 12 days. The mantle passes to Heinrich Figueroa.
d12: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Heinrich Figueroa, 50 — an aquarium keeper. Their hands know different work now: Bloodhound.
d12: The village's quarrel was with Kate — and Kate is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d12: The fire knew Heinrich — solid ground, earned at this fire.

d22: 📖 LEARNED: Stone Tools (Level 1). Flint, chert, obsidian — they break with sharp edges. You can make a cutting tool in minutes.
d22: 📖 LEARNED: Welding & Metalwork (Level 1). Join metal with heat: clean the joint, mind the arc, let it cool slow.
d22: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.

d22: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Heinrich's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d22: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d22: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Susan Gomez, 47 — a blacksmith. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d22: The village's quarrel was with Heinrich — and Heinrich is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d22: At the grave, Austin speaks for Susan — "Heinrich trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d22: The fire knew Susan before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
